title: console: inline-editing a date-only field in record highlights saves the day before east of UTC — it sends local midnight as a UTC instant (the Edit form sends the plain date)
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect, reproduced and measured. Source: 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`). Browser timezone: `Asia/Taipei` (UTC+8).
Filed under the maintainer's direct instruction in this session (2026-10-12: 「你测试遇到的问题创建issue」, then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue」).
Reader: objectui triage (routing), then the `domain:ui` lane's execution seat (the inline date editor in record highlights).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectui is:issue date-only timezone` → 12 hits, all states. `… inline date day before` → 89. Nearest: #10866 (closed: a date-only day read as the day before WEST of UTC in six readers), the read-side mirror. None covers the inline write path east of UTC.

## What happens

Editing a **date-only** field inline in a record's highlights saves **the day before** the chosen date for a user east of UTC.

Measured on `crm_task.due_date`:

| inline edit | the input re-renders as | PATCH body | stored |
|---|---|---|---|
| set 2026-10-16 | 2026/10/15 | `{"due_date":"2026-10-15T16:00:00.000Z"}` | `2026-10-15` |
| set 2026-10-20 | 2026/10/19 | `{"due_date":"2026-10-19T16:00:00.000Z"}` | `2026-10-19` |

The inline path sends **local midnight converted to a UTC instant** for a date-only field, and the server keeps the UTC calendar day. The **Edit form** is not affected: the same change sent `{"due_date":"2026-10-22"}` and stored `2026-10-22`. The create form sent `"2026-10-14"` correctly. Reproduced 2 of 2.

Every user east of UTC who reschedules from the highlights panel (China, the whole of APAC) gets the wrong day. Inferred for other date-only fields that use the same inline editor, such as close dates.

Measurement note: headless Chrome's native picker popup could not be driven, so the value was set by dispatching the input/change events with the ISO date string, which is what a picker selection fires.

## Acceptance

1. The inline editor for a date-only field sends the calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), as the Edit form does, in every timezone.
2. Pin it with a test under a positive and a negative UTC offset.

## Related

#10866 (closed) is the mirror image on the read side: a date-only day shown as the day before, west of UTC.
